## Checklist
- [ ] Branch name follows `issue/<Issue番号>-<短い英字説明>`
- [ ] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Commit messages include the Issue number and follow convention
- [ ] Work was committed at small, coherent checkpoints
- [ ] PR is focused and reviewable
- [ ] No unrelated file changes included
- [ ] Asset / folder `.meta` files are included and conflicting Unity assets were reviewed
- [ ] Generated outputs / credentials / personal settings are excluded
- [ ] Human acceptance results and still-pending tests are distinguished
- [ ] Draft status is kept until dependencies and acceptance are ready; merge uses Squash
